name: World of Pannotia: Dragon Drops
summary: Every Ender Dragon kill drops an Elytra, a Dragon Egg and a Dragon Head, on top of vanilla rewards. The drops are unconditional, so the dragon can be farmed repeatedly.

mechanics.title: Guaranteed dragon loot
mechanics.description: Three separate pools of one roll each, with no conditions (no "killed by player" requirement, no looting scaling): 1 Elytra, 1 Dragon Egg, 1 Dragon Head. Added through minecraft:entities/ender_dragon, which has pool 1 = vanilla:entities/ender_dragon (empty, as in vanilla) and pool 2 = dragon_drops:entities/ender_dragon.

vanilla_changes.change: Vanilla ender dragon has an empty loot table (XP and the egg on the exit portal are handled by game code). The pack adds a guaranteed Elytra, Dragon Egg and Dragon Head item drop to every kill, including repeat kills.

getting_started: Kill the Ender Dragon; the items drop at the point of death alongside the normal XP.
editor_notes: The vanilla Dragon Egg still appears on the exit portal on the first kill, so the first kill gives two eggs. Drops are not gated behind a player kill. Table has no "type" field (harmless).
